# "A Chandra view of dark matter in early-type galaxies".  Transcribed this session from the arXiv:astro-ph/0601301
# LaTeX source (Tables "The galaxy sample", "Best-fitting NFW+stars results", "Stellar mass-to-light ratios").
# LK  : K-band luminosity, 1e11 Lsun (2MASS, corrected to the adopted distance)

# ups_fit  : M*/L_K fitted jointly with the halo (NFW+stars)
# ups_krou, ups_salp : M*/L_K predicted by stellar population synthesis for a Kroupa / Salpeter IMF
